restside.title: Evening Flock — Rest the flights on only one side of the sky
restside.message: resting one half of the sky edits addressed flights once and Step back restores all eighty

copy.rest-side-help: Pause and set flights to zero only on the chosen half of the sky. Places and the other half’s flights stay put. The middle line belongs to the right half. One beat lets the rules answer; Step back restores the edit.
